description.value:
You can spend two uses of Modular Munitions on a single tech power to apply two empowerment effects at once, instead of one. You also gain three new empowerment options:

  • Confusion. Each creature damaged must make a Charisma saving throw; on a failure, on its next turn it must use its action to make a melee attack against a randomly chosen creature within its reach, or do nothing if none is in reach.
  • Knockout. Each creature damaged must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall prone.
  • Static. Each creature damaged must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or become shocked until the start of your next turn.

Additionally, spending 1 tech point to apply an empowerment effect no longer reduces your maximum tech points.
